source.recommendation: Recommend no implicit owner demotion or user-identity rewrite; idempotent existing-member outcome; final-state valid expiry/revocation with shared writer fencing. These exact policies are proposed, not sourced approvals.

sourceEstablished.notOwnerSelectableWithoutNewEvidence: Do not invent a different included seat limit, provider behavior or authority.

alternatives.audit: new joins once; rejected calls write nothing
new member.joined once; existing invitation.accepted_noop once; replay no event

alternatives.extraPrerequisite: Verified reservation subject identity, email/provider normalization and every writer shares reservation fence
Deferred deadline/revocation protocol and tested rollback at COMMIT; current P0 RPC does not implement this guarantee

semantics.expiryBoundary: expiresAt must be strictly greater than chosen observation point; equality rejects
semantics.revocationOrdering: revokedAt <= chosen point rejects; after-lock revocation waits for shared invitation fence and orders after admission if it commits first
semantics.newMember: Issuance authority must be verified within the selected writer contract; recipient identity and token/email mapping must be verified. Recipient need not already be an owner/admin. New member consumes one unique seat; no implicit owner grant. Preserve the explicitly verified invitation role (admin/manager/member/viewer); no default member role or implicit owner invitation.
semantics.existingMember: Recommended noop consumes no extra seat even at capacity; do not demote/promote implicitly; alternative rejects explicitly
semantics.roleChanges: Explicit authorized membership role operation and dedicated ownership-transfer contract are separate unresolved choices
semantics.identityMutation: No generic user_id rewrite recommended; remediation/migration authority remains separate
semantics.reservationIdentity: Oracle input otherReservations counts only verified distinct live reservation subjects excluding the current consumed invitation and any existing member. It does not establish provider/email-to-user equivalence. Current reservation must not be counted twice.
semantics.ownerAuthority: Single versus multiple owners, organizations.owner_user_id consistency and transfer authority remain pending; noop only preserves current owner
semantics.replayBoundary: Define same invitation/token outcome explicitly; no double seat or member.joined event in any proposed branch

currentImplementationDifferences: Captured and P0 acceptance upsert existing role while below capacity; proposed noop/reject alternatives are not implemented or approved
Current P0 rejects repeated redemption; recommended return-prior alternative would need new engineering
Current P0 capacity counts members; occupied-plus-pending reservations are separately guarded Batch17 proposal, not global invariant
Current P0 checks wall clock after last lock, not guaranteed valid at final COMMIT
acceptanceObligations: Existing owner invite cannot silently demote owner
Existing member invitation at five members follows chosen explicit noop/reject semantics with zero extra seat
New distinct user at five members denied
Duplicate token/retry writes at most one joined audit; noop uses explicit separate event
Expiry/revocation tested before and after fence plus chosen final point
All mutations and audits roll back together on late failure
Direct and privileged writer concurrency is included or explicitly blocked
